name: tracking-proof-support-resilience
objective: Close active delivery execution, foreground location, proof-of-delivery, exception/support/rescue, notifications and recovery without leaking protected data or inventing local truth.
truthOwner: DSH owns delivery/status/location-reference/support/incident/rescue operational truth; media service owns governed proof assets; WLT is read-only from rescue.

tasks.currentProblem: Captain runtime sends foreground location only in active states and supports delivery status/PoD, but static code does not prove OS lifecycle, retry queue, media binding, tracking freshness or privacy.
tasks.requiredChange: Test foreground/background transitions, pending-location flush, legal status progression, PoD capture/upload/reference and client/operator readback; change background behavior only if current Product Truth explicitly requires it.
tasks.targetState: Active task survives refresh/restart; location/proof/status are retry-safe and privacy-bounded; client tracking is current without exposing internal Captain data.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not add background tracking merely because foreground-only behavior exists.
Do not persist unnecessary location history on device.
Do not expose customer PII beyond the assigned delivery need.
acceptanceCriteria: Location mutations are actor/assignment scoped and duplicate-safe.
PoD is bound to the correct assignment/order and survives reload through canonical readback.
OS lifecycle/offline/unknown-result recovery cannot fabricate successful delivery.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U005 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.currentProblem: Support Product Truth is discovery and requires assigned-order ownership, internal-note isolation, idempotent incident/rescue transitions and append-only audit.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace CaptainOrderSupportConversationScreen and shared support through backend/database/operator support/OrderRescue; close missing ownership, conflict, attachment/readback, audit and retry behavior.
tasks.targetState: Captain support is available only for assigned orders and converges with operator incident/rescue state; no local-only rescue or financial mutation exists.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not expose internal operator notes to Captain.
Do not let Captain mutate rescue state.
Do not mutate WLT ledger/balance/refund/settlement from DSH rescue.
acceptanceCriteria: Captain cannot open/read support for an unassigned order.
Conflict/retry produces canonical readback and append-only audit where required.
Operator resolution is reflected in Captain recovery flow without local override.
